name: proj4j test fixture: unit square split into two triangles
description: Not a real model. The unit square (0,0)-(1,1) is split along its diagonal into triangle A = v0 v1 v2 (below the diagonal) and triangle B = v0 v2 v3 (above it). The two triangles carry deliberately DIFFERENT affine maps - A is (x,y) -> (2x, 2y), B sends (0,1) to (0,3) - so a point is transformed differently depending on which triangle contains it, and a bug that picks the wrong triangle cannot pass. Kept to four vertices because that is the smallest mesh in which triangle selection is observable.
